Supply and Delivery#001.src: Hey! I- uh, I can't help but notice that. You're still here. With the crate. You need to bring it to {p}, remember?

Supply and Delivery#002.src: Oh, you're one of those {p} soldiers. If I can give some advice?

Supply and Delivery#003.src: You should pick up some items from the Accessory Merchant in town! They might really help you out.

Supply and Delivery#004.src: Normally you can only find accessories in rare cave loot, so a merchant like ours is actually a rarity.

Supply and Delivery#005.src: What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefited from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?

Supply and Delivery#006.src: So either you run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!
Supply and Delivery#006.dst: Так что либо ты везёшь припасы в {p}… либо мы оба сбегаем, начинаем новую жизнь и уходим от последствий!

Supply and Delivery#007.src: Howdy! Lookin' to hitch a ride off to {p}? Sorry to say, but the wagon's broken down.
Supply and Delivery#007.dst: Здорово! Хочешь прокатиться до {p}? Жаль тебя огорчать, но повозка сломалась.

Supply and Delivery#008.src: I reckon it won't be long 'till it's fixed up, but you'll have to make the journey yourself for now.
Supply and Delivery#008.dst: Думаю, её скоро починят, но пока добираться придётся своим ходом.

Supply and Delivery#009.src: This fast travel requires Supply and Delivery to use.
Supply and Delivery#009.dst: Для этой быстрой поездки нужно пройти задание Supply and Delivery.

Supply and Delivery#010.src: I hope these emeralds will suffice. Additionally... we have recently fixed up one of our broken carts, which makes the trip to {p} and back.
Supply and Delivery#010.dst: Надеюсь, этих изумрудов хватит. А ещё… мы недавно починили одну из сломанных повозок, что ездит в {p} и обратно.

Supply and Delivery#012.src: Oh, man... What am I going to do now...
Supply and Delivery#012.dst: Ох… Что же мне теперь делать…
Supply and Delivery#012.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#013.src: O-oh! H-hello soldier! Wow, what a coincidence that we're both here... in {p}... today...
Supply and Delivery#013.dst: О-ой! З-здравствуй, солдат! Надо же, какое совпадение, что мы оба здесь… в {p}… сегодня…
Supply and Delivery#013.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#014.src: What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefitted from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?
Supply and Delivery#014.dst: Что? Не смотри на меня так! Сделка была честной и выгодной обоим. Мне растение, а тебе… ну. Опыт?
Supply and Delivery#014.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#015.src: Look, alright, I get it! But I can't pay you back either way. The mayor sent me here to pick up a crate of supplies for the village.
Supply and Delivery#015.dst: Слушай, ладно, понял! Но вернуть долг я всё равно не могу. Мэр послал меня забрать ящик припасов для деревни.
Supply and Delivery#015.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#016.src: The issue is... I've already run out of money on- uh, unrelated purchases. And even if I had the money, I couldn't buy the supply crate anyway...
Supply and Delivery#016.dst: Беда в том… деньги я уже потратил на… э-э, другие покупки. Да и с деньгами ящик мне не купить…
Supply and Delivery#016.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#017.src: Those two over there who run the market banned me from ever using it after I tried to buy out the world's supplies of magical powders.
Supply and Delivery#017.dst: Те двое, что ведут Торговую площадку, закрыли мне доступ, когда я хотел скупить весь магический порошок в мире.
Supply and Delivery#017.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#018.src: Look, it's not my fault I'm making big market moves. I'm just, you know- smarter than all these other folks!
Supply and Delivery#018.dst: Слушай, я не виноват, что делаю крупные ставки. Просто я, ну… умнее всех этих людей!
Supply and Delivery#018.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#019.src: ... The point is. I could really use your help right now! I- I promise, I'll pay you back for it this time.
Supply and Delivery#019.dst: … В общем. Мне правда нужна твоя помощь! Я… я обещаю, в этот раз всё верну.
Supply and Delivery#019.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#020.src: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. Please?
Supply and Delivery#020.dst: Нужно просто сходить на Торговую площадку и купить мне ящик припасов. Пожалуйста?
Supply and Delivery#020.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#021.src: Oh, man... What am I going to do now...
Supply and Delivery#021.dst: Ох… Что же мне теперь делать…

Supply and Delivery#028.src: ... What? They also banned you from the market?! Well, great. What are we supposed to do now?
Supply and Delivery#028.dst: … Что? Тебя тоже туда не пускают?! Отлично. И что нам теперь делать?
Supply and Delivery#028.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#029.src: Well, do you have any other friends we could get involved? There was... that other soldier guy, right? His name was... Tim. Or something.
Supply and Delivery#029.dst: Ну, а другие друзья у тебя есть? Был же… тот другой солдат, да? Его звали… Tim. Или как-то так.
Supply and Delivery#029.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#030.src: Look- alright, I get it, I'm a jerk who doesn't remember peoples' names! Could you just ask him to buy the supplies for us?? He's our last hope... probably.
Supply and Delivery#030.dst: Слушай, ладно, понял, я гад, который не помнит имён! Можешь просто попросить его купить припасы?? Он наша последняя надежда… наверное.
Supply and Delivery#030.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#031.src: Purchase the supply crate from the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#031.dst: Купи ящик припасов на Торговой площадке на [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#032.src: Hey, good work! Now you'll need to pick up the supply crate.
Supply and Delivery#032.dst: Эй, отлично! Теперь нужно забрать ящик припасов.
Supply and Delivery#032.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#033.src: Find Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and convince him to buy the supply crate for you.
Supply and Delivery#033.dst: Найди Tasim на [{~}, {~}, -{~}] и уговори его купить ящик припасов.

Supply and Delivery#034.src: Oh, hey {u}! Are you just here to hang out? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
Supply and Delivery#034.dst: О, привет, {u}! Просто поболтать? Или… по лицу вижу, что ты по другому делу.
Supply and Delivery#034.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#035.src: [{~}] Can you buy something from the Trade Market for me?
Supply and Delivery#035.dst: [{~}] Купишь мне кое-что на Торговой площадке?

Supply and Delivery#036.src: I... guess so? Is there a reason you can't do it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#036.dst: Я… пожалуй? А что мешает тебе купить?
Supply and Delivery#036.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#037.src: ...You're banned from the market? How did you even manage that? We haven't even been in {p} for that long!
Supply and Delivery#037.dst: …Тебе запрещён вход на площадку? Как такое вообще вышло? Мы в {p} совсем недавно!
Supply and Delivery#037.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#038.src: You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy... whatever it is you need.
Supply and Delivery#038.dst: Ты… что!? Нет, не хочу знать. Идём, веди. Куплю… что бы тебе там ни было нужно.
Supply and Delivery#038.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#039.src: ...Oh. Well, that explains that. Though- is there a reason you can't get it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#039.dst: …А. Ну, это всё объясняет. Но… что мешает тебе взять его?
Supply and Delivery#039.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#040.src: ...You're banned from the market? How did you even manage that? We haven't even been in {p} for that long!

Supply and Delivery#041.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#049.src: Bring Tasim to the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#049.dst: Приведи Tasim на Торговую площадку на [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#050.src: Alright. So I'm just buying a supply crate...
Supply and Delivery#050.dst: Ладно. Значит, я просто покупаю ящик припасов…
Supply and Delivery#050.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#051.src: Here it is. I wish you luck with... whatever it is you're up to.
Supply and Delivery#051.dst: Держи. Удачи… в чём бы ни было твоё дело.
Supply and Delivery#051.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#052.src: Return to Ope with the supply crate at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Supply and Delivery#053.src: Perfect! Now, quickly, come back over here, before those two realize you're working with me!
Supply and Delivery#053.dst: Отлично! А теперь быстро сюда, пока те двое не поняли, что ты со мной заодно!
Supply and Delivery#053.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#054.src: You got the item? Good. Good, good good.
Supply and Delivery#054.dst: Ящик у тебя? Хорошо. Хорошо, хорошо.
Supply and Delivery#054.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#055.src: Okay! Now, we're onto step two. So, you see, this package still needs to make it to {p}...
Supply and Delivery#055.dst: Так! Переходим ко второму шагу. Видишь ли, посылку ещё нужно доставить в {p}…
Supply and Delivery#055.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#056.src: And. Well. You're the one holding the crate, not me! So... you know!
Supply and Delivery#056.dst: И. Ну. Ящик-то у тебя, а не у меня! Так что… сам понимаешь!
Supply and Delivery#056.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#057.src: Great! You know the way by now, surely! No need for me to, uh, get in your way!
Supply and Delivery#057.dst: Отлично! Дорогу ты уже точно знаешь! Не буду, э-э, путаться под ногами!
Supply and Delivery#057.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#058.src: Just take those supplies to {p}, and. Well. Things will work out.
Supply and Delivery#058.dst: Просто отнеси припасы в {p}, и. Ну. Всё как-нибудь уладится.
Supply and Delivery#058.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#060.src: Well, you see. I really don't want to do it. And I'm not going to!
Supply and Delivery#060.dst: Видишь ли. Мне правда не хочется это делать. И я не буду!
Supply and Delivery#060.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#061.src: So you either run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!
Supply and Delivery#061.dst: Так что либо ты везёшь припасы в {p}… либо мы оба сбегаем, начинаем новую жизнь и уходим от последствий!
Supply and Delivery#061.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#062.src: ...no? No. Okay. Worth a shot. Well, you know the way by now! No need for me to, uh, get in your way! Heh...
Supply and Delivery#062.dst: …нет? Нет. Ладно. Попытка не пытка. Дорогу ты знаешь! Не буду, э-э, путаться под ногами! Хе…
Supply and Delivery#062.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#063.src: He bought you the item? Good. Good, good good. Okay! That was... harder than expected.
Supply and Delivery#063.dst: Он купил тебе ящик? Хорошо. Хорошо, хорошо. Так! Это было… сложнее, чем я думал.
Supply and Delivery#063.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#072.src: Bring the supply crate to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#072.dst: Отнеси ящик припасов мэру Alvin в {p} на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#073.src: Ah, hello! What can I do for you today?
Supply and Delivery#073.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#074.src: Ah... So you do. I thought I had sent Ope to pick that up...
Supply and Delivery#074.dst: А… Вот оно что. Я ведь посылал за ним Ope…
Supply and Delivery#074.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#075.src: More of his shenanigans, I suppose. I am sorry you have had to deal with him twice.
Supply and Delivery#075.dst: Опять его проделки, полагаю. Простите, что вам пришлось иметь с ним дело дважды.
Supply and Delivery#075.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#076.src: When he returns to the village, I'm going to need to have a word with him... Ah, but of course, I should pay you for your troubles.
Supply and Delivery#076.dst: Когда он вернётся в деревню, мне придётся с ним поговорить… Ах да, конечно, я должен заплатить вам за хлопоты.
Supply and Delivery#076.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#077.src: I hope these emeralds will suffice. Additionally... we recently fixed up one of our broken carts, which makes the trip to {p} and back.
Supply and Delivery#077.dst: Надеюсь, этих изумрудов хватит. А ещё… мы недавно починили одну из сломанных повозок, что ездит в {p} и обратно.
Supply and Delivery#077.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#078.src: You may feel free to use it whenever you like! As thanks for all you have done for us.
Supply and Delivery#078.dst: Пользуйтесь ею когда угодно! В благодарность за всё, что вы для нас сделали.
Supply and Delivery#078.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#079.src: He's... difficult. He's the son of my sister, who was unfortunately killed by spiders some time ago.
Supply and Delivery#079.dst: Он… непростой. Он сын моей сестры, которую, увы, некоторое время назад убили пауки.
Supply and Delivery#079.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#080.src: With his father out of the picture, I had to take him in. He's a grown man now, yes, but... I fear the loss has taken a toll on us both.
Supply and Delivery#080.dst: Отца рядом не было, и мне пришлось взять его к себе. Он уже взрослый, да, но… боюсь, утрата сказалась на нас обоих.
Supply and Delivery#080.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#081.src: I truly hope he will cease with these ridiculous ploys sometime soon... but I can't bring myself to do more than give him a stern talking to.
Supply and Delivery#081.dst: Искренне надеюсь, что он скоро бросит эти нелепые затеи… но на большее, чем строгий выговор, я не решаюсь.
Supply and Delivery#081.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#082.src: He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. It's alright if you don't feel the same way, though. I will not force you to interact with him if you do not wish to.
Supply and Delivery#082.dst: Он хороший человек, правда. Я верю в это всем сердцем. Но если вы так не считаете - ничего страшного. Я не заставлю вас с ним общаться, если не хотите.
Supply and Delivery#082.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#083.src: Oh, dear... I suppose it must have been fifteen years ago that I took the position, when the old mayor stepped down.
Supply and Delivery#083.dst: Ох… Кажется, лет пятнадцать назад я занял этот пост, когда прежний мэр ушёл в отставку.
Supply and Delivery#083.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#084.src: He was a kind man, always looking out for the townsfolk. Though, by the time he retired, it was clear he was growing restless in our little town.
Supply and Delivery#084.dst: Он был добрым человеком, всегда заботился о горожанах. Но к отставке стало ясно, что в нашем городке ему не сидится.
Supply and Delivery#084.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#085.src: Well, as soon as he passed down the position to me, he immediately traveled to {p} and enlisted in their army! I hear he's in the business of training soldiers these days.
Supply and Delivery#085.dst: Так вот, едва передав мне пост, он тут же отправился в {p} и вступил в армию! Слышал, теперь он обучает солдат.
Supply and Delivery#085.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#086.src: Ah, but I've tried lived up to his legacy. I like to think I've done well in my time as mayor!
Supply and Delivery#086.dst: Ах, но я старался быть достойным его наследия. Хочется думать, мэр из меня вышел неплохой!
Supply and Delivery#086.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#087.src: A fine day for passing through! I hope you enjoy your stay.
Supply and Delivery#087.dst: Чудный день для путников! Приятного вам пребывания.
Supply and Delivery#087.speaker: Mayor Alvin
